title: Maven Prime project configuration
description: Project-level Maven Prime configuration, checked into version control at the reactor root.

defaults.description: Team values for the global build context. Every developer inherits these unless they change the value locally; Reset to Defaults drops the local changes.

profiles.description: Profile id to enabled state, applied to every build and to the IDE Maven import. false renders as !profile. A developer who sets the profile locally keeps their own state.

properties.description: User properties applied to every build and, unless excluded per property, to the IDE Maven import. An empty value renders as -Dkey, which Maven reads as true; use options for a literal -Dkey=.

forceClean.description: Put the clean phase in front of every build that runs a lifecycle phase.

goals.description: Project-scoped goals, shared with everyone who checks out this repository.

name.description: Label shown in the Goals tab. The goal line is used when omitted.

goals.description: Lifecycle phases and plugin goals, in execution order. Replaces the goals already set.

settingsFile.description: Maven user settings file (-s). Blank uses the IDE Maven settings.

pomFileName.description: POM file name (-f) when it is not pom.xml.

profiles.description: Profile id to enabled state, merged over the profiles already set. false renders as !profile, null removes the profile.

properties.description: User properties rendered as -Dkey=value, merged over the properties already set. An empty value renders as -Dkey, which Maven reads as true; null removes the property.

flags.description: Maven Prime option toggles, added to the toggles already set.

projects.description: Module selectors (-pl). Replaces the selectors already set.

options.description: Extra command line options, parsed like a shell argument list.

jre.description: JRE name, or one of the IDE placeholders such as #JAVA_HOME.

vmOptions.description: JVM options for the Maven process.

environment.description: Maven installation and JVM the build context runs with. A run inherits every field it does not set itself.

settingsFile.description: Maven user settings file (-s). Blank uses the IDE Maven settings.

jre.description: JRE name, or one of the IDE placeholders such as #JAVA_HOME.

vmOptions.description: JVM options for the Maven process.

kind.description: CONTEXT follows the build context's Maven, which is what an unset distribution means. IDE follows the IDE Maven settings, including the Maven wrapper.

path.description: Installation directory. Required for MAVEN_HOME and MVND_HOME.
